Steel Magnolias is Coming to Clarksville!

The Clarksville Community Players are proud to announce our production of Steel Magnolias on November 13, 14 & 15, 2026. Although it has been done by CCP in the past, it will be the first production of the play in the area for almost a decade. Doing a little research in preparation for directing this show, I discovered some interesting things about the true-life story that inspired the author who wrote Steel Magnolias. 

Auditions for the CCP production of Steel Magnolias will be Friday, August 14 from 7-9pm and Saturday, August 15 from 2-4pm at the Clarksville Fine Arts Center (914 Virginia Avenue Clarksville, VA). Anyone wishing to audition should go to the CCP website (clarksvilleplayers.org) to fill out the Google form before the audition. You do not have to prepare anything in advance. We will be doing cold readings from the script with everyone reading several different parts.  People are encouraged to come to both auditions, but that is not a requirement to get a part.  If you have any questions, feel free to contact the director, Andrea Stehle at magistrastehle@gmail.com.
